title: Grade 5 8.1
description: Learning Outcomes for Grade 5: Understand data collection and organisation | Identify methods of data collection | Organise data in tables | Identify common data displays | Understand graph purposes | Recognise chance events | Identify possible outcomes | Identify probability outcomes | Identify impossible events | Compare likelihoods | Interpret graph data | Compare data values | Express probability as fractions | Calculate probability fractions | Calculate probability of multiple outcomes | Interpret data displays | Interpret probability experiments | Connect fractions and data | Solve probability problems | Analyse and interpret data
